positions.name: Moderna, Inc.
positions.catalyst: Nasdaq announced Thursday (Oct 1) that Moderna joins the Nasdaq-100 before the Oct 9 open, replacing Warner Bros. Discovery (exiting on the Paramount-Skydance deal close). Index funds tracking the NDX (>$800B in 200+ products) must buy into the Oct 8 close.
positions.driver: Fresh, mechanical forced-buying catalyst with a known date; pre-market reaction only +1.7% ($192.16 vs $188.94 close), so most of the passive demand window is still ahead. Stock is in a strong September uptrend ($135 → $203 high 9/29) and pulled back ~7% from that high into the announcement. Futures green (Nasdaq +0.6%) ahead of payrolls.
positions.risks: Extremely volatile (~6x YTD, 5-8% daily ranges); index-add pops are often front-run and sold into; an analyst 'sell' call circulating; 8:30am ET September payrolls can swing the whole tape. Hard stop $178.71 (-7%), below the 9/30 low ($184.58) and Oct 1 low ($186.01).
